{{Top|leg}}
'''Frequency J-45-411-K77''' was a communications channel used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] arriving at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. The frequency was to be used by ships that had a medical emergency aboard to allow a medical team to be present at landing.
